settings.title: Reconciliation Settings
settings.subtitle: Parameters for the ERP x Acquirer reconciliation process.
settings.schedulingSubtitle: Controls when and how the NimbusFlow automatic pipeline runs.
settings.processingSubtitle: Transaction lookup window for ERP x Acquirer reconciliation.
settings.reconciliationSubtitle: Tolerances and per-step reprocessing for the reconciliation pipeline.
settings.schedulerEnabledHint: Enables or disables automatic pipeline execution. Manual endpoints continue to work even when this flag is off.
settings.completePipelineEnabledHint: Enables the full pipeline run (ERP → Acquirer → Bank → Reconciliation). When disabled the scheduler wakes up but does nothing.
settings.completePipelineCronHint: 6-field Spring cron (seconds minutes hours day month weekday). Changes take effect only after a server restart.
settings.completePipelineStopOnStepErrorHint: When enabled, the pipeline halts subsequent steps if a step throws an exception. Parallel-execution conflicts never stop the pipeline.
settings.logIdleCyclesHint: Emits a debug log each cycle the scheduler wakes up but is disabled. Recommended off in production to avoid log noise.
settings.schedulerSaveError: Could not save the scheduling settings.
settings.erpAcquirerPreviousDaysLookbackHint: Defines how many days before the ERP sale date the acquirer may have recorded the transaction. Set to 0 to require the exact same day.
settings.erpAcquirerFutureDaysLookbackHint: Defines how many days after the ERP sale date the acquirer may have recorded the transaction. Set to 0 to require the exact same day.
settings.reconciliationLookbackMonthsHint: Defines how many months prior to the current date should be searched for transactions during reconciliation. Default: 120 months.
settings.creditOrderPendingDaysHint: Summaries with an RV date older than this number of days and without payment orders are listed as pending for batch creation.
settings.enabledSubtitle: When disabled, the step is skipped (SKIPPED) and the remaining steps continue normally.
settings.reprocessSubtitle: Allows each pipeline step to process already-reconciled records. Use only for audits or targeted corrections — disable after use.
settings.reprocessErpAcquirerSalesHint: Reprocesses ERP sales already reconciled with the acquirer.
settings.reprocessSalesSummaryTransactionsHint: Reprocesses summaries whose transactionsStatus is already reconciled.
settings.reprocessAcquirerSaleCancellationsHint: Reprocesses sales already marked as cancelled by the acquirer.
settings.reprocessErpAcquirerFeesHint: Reprocesses transactions whose feeReconciliationStatus is already reconciled.
settings.reprocessAcquirerSaleSummary: Step 5 — Acquirer Sale x Sales Summary
settings.reprocessAcquirerSaleSummaryHint: Reprocesses summaries whose transactionsStatus is already reconciled.
settings.reprocessSalesSummaryCreditOrder: Step 6 — Sales Summary x Payment Order
settings.reprocessSalesSummaryCreditOrderHint: Reprocesses summaries whose creditOrderStatus is already reconciled.
settings.reprocessBankAcquirer: Step 7 — Payment Order x Bank Statement
settings.reprocessBankAcquirerHint: Reprocesses already-paid credit orders and already-reconciled bank releases.
settings.strictMatchingSubtitle: By default, flag, establishment and payment kind are optional when matching a bank release against a credit order/installment — null or unknown on either side is accepted. Turn these on to require each field and reduce wrong reconciliations.
settings.flagMatchRequiredHint: Requires the bank release's flag and the credit order's/installment's flag to match. Today, a missing flag on either side is accepted as a wildcard.
settings.establishmentMatchRequiredHint: Requires the bank release's establishment (PV) number and the credit order's/installment's to match. Before enabling, confirm PV extraction from the CNAB file is reliable — see the impact diagnostics.
settings.paymentKindMatchRequiredHint: Requires the bank release's payment kind (debit or credit) and the credit order's/installment's to match. Today, an unknown payment kind on either side is accepted as a wildcard.
settings.dateToleranceDaysBeforeHint: Days before allowed (bank). Days a bank release can be BEFORE the credit order date. Recommended: 0 (avoids false positives).
settings.dateToleranceDaysAfterHint: Days after allowed (bank). Days a bank release can be AFTER the credit order date. Recommended: 5.
settings.valueToleranceHint: Value tolerance. Maximum monetary difference tolerated in a reconciliation. E.g. 0.05 accepts up to 5 cents of divergence.
settings.bankMarkNotReconciledAfterDaysHint: Days to mark as unreconciled. Bank releases without a match in the last N days remain pending. After this period, they are marked as unreconciled.
settings.subsetDpMaxCentsHint: Combination cap. Maximum value, entered in R$ (converted internally to cents), attempted when searching for a combination of credit orders (subset-sum) to close a bank release. Above this cap, the release stays pending even with compatible orders available. E.g. R$ 500,000.00.
settings.legacyMarkingSubtitle: Controls which bank releases can be manually marked as pre–go-live, based on the release date.
settings.goLiveDateHint: Date the system went live. Used by the reconciliation pipeline to ignore earlier dates and as the reference for the legacy marking window.
settings.legacyMarkingMonthsHint: Legacy Marking Months. Only releases dated up to go-live + N months can be marked as legacy. For later releases, the button is hidden in manual reconciliation.

manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyFlagsSuccess: Pending releases analyzed: {analyzed}. Flags fixed: {updated}. Still unresolved: {stillUnresolved}.
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyModalityTooltip: Fixes the modality (debit/credit) of receipt releases with no modality identified, invisible in the bank statement listing (one-time backfill)
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyModalityConfirmMessage: Reclassify the modality (debit/credit) of receipt releases with no modality identified, from the bank's historical text? Releases with no debit/credit signal at all in the text (e.g. TED, SISPAG, corrections) are left unchanged.
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyModalitySuccess: Releases analyzed: {analyzed}. Modality fixed: {updated}. Still unresolved: {stillUnresolved}.
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyAcquirerTooltip: Links the acquirer of receipt releases with no acquirer identified, from the bank's historical text or document (one-time backfill) — run before Reclassify Establishment
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyAcquirerConfirmMessage: Link the acquirer of receipt releases with no acquirer identified, from the bank's historical text or document? Releases with no recognizable acquirer signal in the text are left unchanged.
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyAcquirerSuccess: Releases analyzed: {analyzed}. Acquirer linked: {updated}. Still unresolved: {stillUnresolved}.
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyEstablishmentTooltip: Links the establishment of receipt releases with no establishment identified, from the PV found in the bank's historical text or document (one-time backfill)
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyEstablishmentConfirmMessage: Link the establishment of receipt releases with no establishment identified, from the PV found in the bank's historical text or document? Releases with no recognizable PV in the text (e.g. PIX, TED) are left unchanged.
manualBankReconciliation.reclassifyEstablishmentSuccess: Releases analyzed: {analyzed}. Establishment linked: {updated}. Still unresolved: {stillUnresolved}.
manualBankReconciliation.preImplantationAnalyzeTooltip: Analyzes pending releases whose available credit orders sum below the release value (pre-implantation sales with no order in the system) — writes nothing, just previews what would be linked
manualBankReconciliation.preImplantationDialogMessage: Releases below whose available credit orders sum (same company/bank/acquirer/flag, within the configured date window) falls below the release value. Linking applies the standard pre-implantation-sales justification to all eligible releases.
manualBankReconciliation.preImplantationSelectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
manualBankReconciliation.preImplantationApplyConfirmMessage: Automatically link {eligible, plural, =0 {no releases} one {# eligible release} other {# eligible releases}}, applying the standard pre-implantation-sales justification? This is recalculated at execution time and cannot be undone in bulk.
manualBankReconciliation.preImplantationApplySuccess: Releases analyzed: {analyzed}. Linked: {linked}. Orders exceeding release value: {skippedNegativeDifference}. No candidate orders: {skippedNoCandidates}.
manualBankReconciliation.noCreditOrderLegacyAnalyzeTooltip: Analyzes pending releases with no candidate credit order at all, within the configured legacy window — writes nothing, just previews what would be marked as legacy
manualBankReconciliation.noCreditOrderLegacyDialogMessage: Releases below have no candidate credit order at all (same company/bank/acquirer/flag, within the configured date window) and fall within the legacy window (go-live + configured months). Marking has the same effect as the manual "Mark as Legacy" button, applied to all eligible releases.
manualBankReconciliation.noCreditOrderLegacySelectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
manualBankReconciliation.noCreditOrderLegacyApplyConfirmMessage: Mark as legacy {eligible, plural, =0 {no releases} one {# eligible release} other {# eligible releases}}? This is recalculated at execution time and cannot be undone in bulk.
manualBankReconciliation.noCreditOrderLegacyApplySuccess: Releases analyzed: {analyzed}. Marked as legacy: {marked}. With candidate orders: {skippedHasCandidates}. Outside legacy window: {skippedOutsideLegacyWindow}.
manualBankReconciliation.salesSummaryPreImplantationAnalyzeToolti: Analyzes Sales Summaries from before implantation whose installments (credit orders) only fall due after go-live and are therefore never re-evaluated by the normal flow — nothing is saved, only estimates the result
manualBankReconciliation.salesSummaryPreImplantationDialogTitle: Pre-implantation backfill — Sales Summary vs Credit Order
manualBankReconciliation.salesSummaryPreImplantationDialogMessage: Sales Summaries from before implantation are never re-evaluated by the normal Summary vs Order reconciliation flow (even when the installment falls due well after go-live). Apply re-evaluates these summaries at once, using the same logic as the normal flow (order sum, synthetic generation when applicable).
manualBankReconciliation.salesSummaryPreImplantationApplyConfirmM: Re-evaluate all pending pre-implantation Sales Summaries now? This action is recalculated at execution time and cannot be undone in bulk.
manualBankReconciliation.salesSummaryPreImplantationApplySuccess: Analyzed: {summariesAnalyzed}. Reconciled: {summariesReconciled}. Partial: {summariesPartiallyReconciled}. Pending: {summariesPending}. Synthetic orders generated: {generatedCreditOrders}.
manualBankReconciliation.creditOrderPreImplantationAnalyzeTooltip: Analyzes orphaned credit orders (without a linked sales summary) from before implantation, looking for the matching summary by acquirer+RV — nothing is saved, only estimates what would be linked
manualBankReconciliation.creditOrderPreImplantationDialogMessage: Orphaned credit orders (without a linked sales summary) from before implantation, matched by acquirer+RV against existing summaries. Apply automatically links only the exact match (same PV); mismatched PV is left out, needs manual review.
manualBankReconciliation.creditOrderPreImplantationPvMismatchHint: The RV matches, but the order's establishment (PV) differs from the sales summary — never linked automatically.
manualBankReconciliation.creditOrderPreImplantationApplyConfirmMe: Automatically link {eligible, plural, =0 {no orders} one {# eligible order} other {# eligible orders}} (exact match)? This action is recalculated at execution time and cannot be undone in bulk.
manualBankReconciliation.creditOrderPreImplantationApplySuccess: Analyzed: {analyzed}. Linked: {linked}. Mismatched PV: {pvMismatch}. No matching summary: {noMatch}.

pipeline.description: Runs the full financial reconciliation pipeline in sequence (ERP, Rede, Bank and reconciliations).

stepMessage.ERP_ACQUIRER: ERP vs Acquirer reconciliation complete. Includes reprocessing of manual entries with swapped NSU/authorization. Only reconciled sales here are eligible for fee adjustments.
stepMessage.SALES_SUMMARY_TRANSACTION: Summaries updated based on ADQ transaction status. Summaries without transactions are marked as reconciled.
stepMessage.ACQUIRER_SALE_CANCELLATION: Full cancellations reported by the acquirer were propagated to ADQ and ERP before fees and summaries.
stepMessage.ACQUIRER_SALE_ADJUSTMENTS: Sales with matching or absent (normalized) contract rates advance. Fee divergences block subsequent steps.
stepMessage.ACQUIRER_SALE_SUMMARY: A summary only reconciles when its linked ADQ sales are eligible from previous steps.
stepMessage.SALES_SUMMARY_CREDIT_ORDER: Debit/anticipation without an order may generate a synthetic order for analysis.
stepMessage.CREDIT_ORDER_BANK_RELEASE: A credit order is only eligible when its linked summary is already reconciled.
stepMessage.SKIPPED: Step skipped — no data to process or a previous step was blocked.
